implementation: Application-owned standard-library stdio tools server, paired with the qualified Hermes MCP client
modern_protocol: 2026-07-28 required per-request version/capabilities, optional client identity, stateless discovery/tool operations, complete result types, server identity metadata, unsupported-version errors, cancellation and EOF shutdown
capabilities: Static typed tools only. Resources, prompts, server-initiated inputs and subscriptions are not advertised. Browser tools preserve their original authorization and navigation boundaries.
tests: Actual isolated subprocess pairs using standalone.mcp_client and standalone.mcp_server for both eras; original browser_harness MCP entry through its real daemon and independent CDP wire fixture; invalid metadata, unsupported versions, schema errors, cancellation, EOF and unnegotiated result variants. No protocol SDK namespace replacement.
